# Write executable Slice 1 behavior specifications

## Purpose

Translate the Slice 1 Kanbus stories into executable specifications before production configuration, hooks, publishing behavior, or CI enforcement is implemented.

## Deliverables

- Cover stable story workspace initialization.
- Cover coaching, failed transitions, successful transitions, and supported revision paths.
- Cover deterministic publication, generated markers, divergence detection, and hand-authored exclusions.
- Cover evidence classification for coaching, blocks, recovery, false positives, intervention, and inconclusive zero-signal runs.
- Provide a disposable fixture environment that cannot be mistaken for the real-story proof.

## Verification

Run the new specifications and record that they fail for the expected missing-behavior reasons before production work begins. No specification may encode internal implementation structure.
payload.title: Write executable Slice 1 behavior specifications
